title: GRAD.------RT.ALGN.
description: Second diagram on page 235 (T(IMP)M-33). The crossing diagrams how gradualism structurally meets reality-alignment at the western-fixation scale: GRAD crossed with RT-ALGN. GRAD sits at left with the subject-arrow; RT-ALGN at right as partner-axis. INFO-TRNS (information transference) branches upward from the main line and carries CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis), which carries R-INTR, which carries CN-INFO (controlled information). AFN (affinity negation) branches to the right and carries POL-P (political policies), which carries APL-DT (application dictates). CULT-COD drops from the main line and carries PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), which carries CULT-AF-DT.
